news.title: Sonia Bompastor praises Chelsea character after Man City victory
news.title_zh: 曼城获胜后索尼娅·邦帕斯特称赞切尔西的品格
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor praised her players' character and defensive performance after Chelsea beat Manchester City 1-0 at Stamford Bridge to move to the top of the Women's Super League. Sandy Baltimore's stunning strike on the stroke of half-time proved decisive, as the Blues claimed a huge three points against our title rivals and ended City's unbeaten start to the season. The victory was particularly important after Chelsea dropped points in the league against Everton last weekend and suffered a Champions League stalemate against BK Hacken during the week. Bompastor was delighted with the response from her players, highlighting the hard work and determination required to keep a dangerous City attack at bay. 'I am happy. Credit to my players. We showed a lot of character coming into the game today. It was not easy, especially on the back of the points we dropped in the league last weekend and in the Champions League,' the Chelsea head coach said. 'The players worked really hard, and the performance was a good one. Especially not to concede a goal against this side, Manchester City, so I think it was a strong defensive performance.' One of the standout performers was young defender Veerle Buurman, who came on after just 12 minutes following an injury to Kadeisha Buchanan. She helped keep City's leading scorer Khadija Shaw quiet throughout the contest. Bompastor was particularly pleased with the way the team dealt with the striker, while also praising Buurman's individual contribution. 'You know, when you come into this game, you try to keep her [Shaw] quiet as much as possible. When it is the case at the beginning of the game, that is good, but you have to do it for the whole game and the 90-plus minutes,' she explained. 'I felt Veerle Buurman had an exceptional game. Being young but being able not to let her have a lot of opportunities was a strong performance, but the whole team had a really strong performance in terms of the defensive aspect.' Bompastor was also asked about Katie McCabe's message to the team to 'play like dogs' before the game, and was happy with whatever approach helped her players deliver on the pitch. 'If that makes them good and happy, then I'm happy for them to play like dogs or cats or whatever they want,' she added. 'We have shown this season that we are doing well in not being easy to break down, and today was another opportunity to show that. To do that against the top teams is a nice feeling.'
news.body_zh: 切尔西在斯坦福桥以 1-0 击败曼城，登上女超联赛榜首后，索尼娅·邦帕斯托赞扬了她的球员的性格和防守表现。桑迪·巴尔的摩在半场结束时的惊人进球起到了决定性的作用，蓝军在对阵冠军对手的比赛中拿下三分，结束了曼城本赛季不败的开局。这场胜利尤其重要，因为切尔西上周末在联赛中对阵埃弗顿的比赛中丢分，并在本周的欧冠联赛中与哈肯队陷入僵局。邦帕斯特对球员们的反应感到高兴，强调了阻止危险的曼城进攻所需的努力和决心。 '我很高兴。感谢我的球员们。今天我们在比赛中展现了很多性格。这并不容易，尤其是在上周末我们在联赛和冠军联赛中丢分的情况下，”切尔西主教练说道。 “球员们非常努力，表现也很好。尤其是在对阵曼城的比赛中没有丢球，所以我认为这是一场强有力的防守表现。”年轻后卫维尔勒·布尔曼 (Veerle Buurman) 是表现最出色的球员之一，他在卡德伊莎·布坎南 (Kadeisha Buchanan) 受伤后仅 12 分钟就上场。她帮助曼城队的头号得分手卡迪嘉·肖在整场比赛中保持安静。邦帕斯特对球队处理这位前锋的方式特别满意，同时也赞扬了布尔曼的个人贡献。 “你知道，当你进入这个游戏时，你会尽力让她[肖]保持安静。比赛一开始就是这样，那很好，但你必须在整场比赛和 90 多分钟里都这样做，”她解释道。 “我觉得维尔勒·布尔曼打了一场出色的比赛。年轻但不能让她有很多机会是一个很强的表现，但整个球队在防守方面的表现非常强。庞帕斯特还被问及凯蒂·麦凯布在赛前向球队传达的“像狗一样踢球”的信息，并对帮助她的球员在球场上表现的任何方法感到满意。 “如果这让他们感到美好和快乐，那么我很高兴他们能像狗或猫一样玩耍，或者他们想要的任何东西，”她补充道。 “本赛季我们已经证明，我们在不易崩溃方面做得很好，今天是另一个证明这一点的机会。与顶级球队对抗是一种很好的感觉。

news.title: Lucy Bronze on Chelsea's consistency against 'top' Manchester City
news.title_zh: 露西·青铜谈切尔西对阵“顶级”曼城的稳定性
news.body_en: Lucy Bronze delivered an outstanding defensive performance as Chelsea beat Manchester City 1-0 at Stamford Bridge to move above our title rivals and take the top spot in the Women's Super League. Sandy Baltimore's stunning strike on the stroke of half-time proved decisive, but Bronze and her defensive team-mates also played a crucial role in keeping City's dangerous attack at bay. The England international reflected on the challenge of facing City's prolific attacking duo, how the Blues restricted the visitors' threat and the consistency that has taken us to the top of the table. Bronze relished testing herself against the best players in the game, and was particularly pleased with how Chelsea dealt with the threat posed by Lauren Hemp and Khadija Shaw, who have been in fine form for City this season. 'I always say I love playing against top players,' Bronze explained. 'They have two specifically in Lauren Hemp and Khadija Shaw. They are magic for Man City this season, and they can't stop scoring. 'We had to be dogs in this game because we couldn’t give them any chances. We were very focused on that. I think it was Katie McCabe who might have said that! Just be in them and around them, don't let them get any chances, as we know how good they are as players. They just need one chance to score.' Bronze was particularly impressive in her battle with Shaw, using her experience and strength to limit the striker's opportunities and prevent her from getting into dangerous positions inside the penalty area. Lucy continued: 'She's so strong and powerful, that's a big part of her game. You just have to challenge her as best as you can. We restricted her and her movement. She doesn't need much space to turn and shoot, so we restricted her today to just a lot of long balls around the halfway line.' The Chelsea defender also knows Hemp well from their time together with England, with the pair regularly facing each other in training. That familiarity made the contest an enjoyable challenge, although Bronze knew she would need to be fully focused to keep the winger quiet. Lucy continued: 'She's a great player and someone that I play against a lot with England. In training, we're always against each other, at right-back and left-wing, so I love the challenge. I know what a good player she is, how much she challenges me and how much I need to be focused in a game like today. I think I dealt with it pretty well.' The victory lifted Chelsea to the top of the WSL, one point ahead of City, and maintained our unbeaten start to the season in all competitions. Bronze believes that consistency has been a major factor in the team's strong position, even without one prolific goalscorer leading the way. 'We've been consistent all season, but we just haven't been prolific with goals and a main goalscorer,' Lucy added. 'But we've performed well in every game, arguably not against Everton last weekend, but we have been consistent. 'The team has been consistent even when we have changed line-ups, the same in the Champions League as well. We've built a really good group of players who are constantly there and constantly fighting, and we are always ready. Even when making changes in the first half, we just keep going and going.'
news.body_zh: 露西·青铜凭借出色的防守表现，帮助切尔西在斯坦福桥以 1-0 击败曼城，超越了争冠对手，登上了女足超级联赛榜首的位置。桑迪·巴尔的摩在半场结束时的惊人进球被证明是决定性的，但布朗兹和她的防守队友也在阻止曼城危险的进攻方面发挥了至关重要的作用。这位英格兰国脚反思了面对曼城多产进攻组合的挑战，蓝军如何限制客队的威胁，以及让我们登上积分榜榜首的稳定性。布朗很享受在比赛中与最好的球员对抗的考验，并且对切尔西如何应对劳伦·汉普和卡迪贾·肖构成的威胁感到特别满意，他们本赛季在曼城的状态良好。 “我总是说我喜欢与顶级选手比赛，”青铜解释道。 “他们有两个特别是劳伦·汉普（Lauren Hemp）和卡迪嘉·肖（Khadija Shaw）。他们本赛季对曼城来说是神奇的，他们无法停止进球。 “在这场比赛中我们必须像狗一样，因为我们不能给他们任何机会。我们非常关注这一点。我认为凯蒂·麦凯布可能会这么说！只要在他们身边，在他们身边，不要让他们有任何机会，因为我们知道他们作为球员有多出色。他们只需要一次进球机会。”布朗兹在与肖的战斗中表现尤其出色，她利用自己的经验和力量限制了前锋的机会，并阻止她进入禁区内的危险位置。露西继续说道：“她非常强大，这是她比赛的重要组成部分。你只需要尽你所能地挑战她。我们限制了她和她的行动。她不需要太多的转身和射门空间，所以今天我们限制她只能在中场线附近进行大量长传。”这位切尔西后卫在与英格兰队的比赛中也对汉普很了解，两人经常在训练中面对面。这种熟悉感使这场比赛成为一项令人愉快的挑战，尽管青铜知道她需要完全集中注意力才能让边锋保持安静。露西继续说道：“她是一位伟大的球员，也是我在英格兰队经常与之交手的球员。在训练中，我们总是在右后卫和左翼对抗，所以我喜欢这种挑战。我知道她是一位多么优秀的球员，她给我带来了多大的挑战，也知道我在今天这样的比赛中需要多么专注。我想我处理得很好。这场胜利让切尔西领先曼城一分，登上女超级联赛榜首，并保持了赛季各项赛事不败的开局。布朗兹认为，即使没有一位高产射手带头，稳定性也是球队保持强势地位的一个主要因素。 “我们整个赛季都很稳定，但我们的进球数和主要射手还不够多，”露西补充道。 “但我们在每场比赛中都表现出色，可以说不是上周末对阵埃弗顿的比赛，但我们一直保持稳定。 “即使我们改变了阵容，球队仍然保持稳定，在冠军联赛中也是如此。我们已经建立了一支非常优秀的球员队伍，他们一直在场，不断战斗，我们时刻准备着。即使在上半场做出了改变，我们也会继续前进。”

news.title: Chizaram Ezenwata on his goalscoring form and hidden talent
news.title_zh: Chizaram Ezenwata 谈他的进球方式和隐藏的天赋
news.body_en: At just 18 years old, Chizaram Ezenwata is already making a significant impression at Cobham. The young forward has enjoyed a superb start to the 2026/27 season, finding the net eight times for Harry Hudson’s Cobham Next Gen side and earning a Premier League 2 Player of the Month nomination back in September. Having stepped up to the CNG squad, Ezenwata has quickly adapted to the demands of PL2 football, becoming an increasingly important figure within the squad. His progress is another step in an exciting journey with the Blues, having developed into one of the side's leading attacking threats since joining the club at 15. While his performances on the pitch continue to attract attention, there is more to the young forward than his goalscoring ability. Away from football, Ezenwata recently surprised supporters with a rather different talent, as a video of him playing the piano attracted plenty of attention online. It is an interest he has held since childhood and offers a glimpse into the person behind the footballer. We recently sat down with Ezenwata to discuss his impressive start to the campaign, his development at Cobham, the responsibility of his role within the squad and his ambitions for the remainder of the campaign. 'I can't complain about the start of the season and the eight goals,' Ezenwata explains. 'I’d like it to be higher but that’s just me as a striker. I’ve been playing up with the Under-21s and I feel like I am confident, getting more comfortable and really growing.' One of his standout performances was in the EFL Trophy against Reading in October, when Ezenwata scored a brace in our 2-0 win at the Select Car Leasing Stadium. Aside from his well-taken goals, what was noticeable was the 18-year-old’s strength and ability to hold up play against senior opposition. Ezenwata revealed that this was an area of his game that he has focused on improving further since stepping up to the CNG side. He said: 'I really enjoyed the Reading game; it was a good challenge for me. Obviously, wanting to play first team, having that experience in the EFL Trophy and managing to get two goals, I’m really proud of myself for that. 'I feel like I've adapted to the conditions, obviously with my physical prowess as well. One of my big developing points is my hold-up play; I’ve been working on it more in training, doing the extras. In terms of my finishing, I'm just carrying that on as well.' Despite only turning 18 in September, Ezenwata has become a key figure in our Cobham Next Gen side, taking on the vice-captaincy and leading by example on and off the pitch. He also wore the captain’s armband against Flora Tallinn in the UEFA Youth League first leg, and popped up with a goal in that game. The Blues striker admitted he feels the responsibility but enjoys the role and having his teammates’ trust. He said: 'It means a lot to have this role, so I’m going to keep pushing. From the start of the season to now, you can see the togetherness has grown. We’re all interlinked as one. Playing together more, we just understand each’s abilities and personalities.' Since arriving at Chelsea, Ezenwata has developed rapidly. Last season, he registered 21 goals and nine assists across all competitions, including the opener in our Under-18 Premier League National Final victory against Manchester City at Stamford Bridge to help us seal the title. That followed an impressive 2024/25 campaign in which Ezenwata was a regular starter for the Under-18s and finished as the team’s top scorer. He has since led the line for CNG and recently signed a new contract, keeping him at the club until at least June 2029. Reflecting on the journey with the Blues so far, Ezenwata said: 'Coming to Chelsea when I was fifteen, I was very excited. My family and I were all proud and Chelsea is the world to me now; being full-time, playing week in, week out and enjoying my football. 'Last season’s final against Man City, winning that final, was my proudest moment so far at Chelsea. The emotions at full time were unreal, seeing everyone coming onto the pitch. 'This season, it’s been signing my new deal. It's another step in the right direction and shows my hard work is paying off, so I'm going to keep working hard and strive for more.' Away from football, Ezenwata remains incredibly talented. His skill for playing the piano recently attracted attention online, which surprised the young forward. Ezenwata told us: 'I didn’t expect that many people to be there; you can see at the end of the video when I was looking around. I started playing when I was four years old, teaching myself with YouTube and learning nursery rhymes. I’ve kept doing it ever since - it helps me relax.' The song Ezenwata performed in the video is his favourite to play as it’s the most recent he’s learned and took ‘a while’ to perfect. However, it’s not the most difficult he’s learned, with Drowning Love by Chasing Kou taking top spot. Looking ahead to the remainder of the season, Ezenwata has set himself the target of becoming Premier League 2 top goalscorer and vows to keep working hard to make it happen. He'll have a chance to add to his growing tally at the end of the month when we face Norwich City.
news.body_zh: 年仅 18 岁的 Chizaram Ezenwata 已经在科巴姆留下了深刻的印象。这位年轻前锋在 2026/27 赛季取得了出色的开局，为哈里·哈德森 (Harry Hudson) 的科巴姆下一代 (Cobham Next Gen) 球队攻入八次进球，并在 9 月份获得英超联赛 2 月最佳球员提名。进入 CNG 队后，Ezenwata 很快适应了 PL2 足球的要求，成为队内越来越重要的人物。他的进步是蓝军激动人心的旅程中又迈出了一步，自 15 岁加入俱乐部以来，他已发展成为球队的主要进攻威胁之一。虽然他在球场上的表现继续吸引人们的关注，但这位年轻前锋的能力远不止他的进球能力。在足球之外，Ezenwata 最近以一种截然不同的天赋让支持者感到惊讶，因为他弹钢琴的视频在网上引起了广泛关注。这是他从小就有的兴趣，让我们可以一睹这位足球运动员背后的人。我们最近采访了 Ezenwata，讨论了他在赛季中令人印象深刻的开局、他在科巴姆的发展、他在球队中的角色责任以及他对赛季剩余时间的抱负。 “我不能抱怨赛季的开始和八个进球，”埃森瓦塔解释道。 “我希望它更高，但这只是我作为前锋的情况。我一直在为 21 岁以下青年队效力，我觉得自己很自信，变得更加舒适，并且真正成长。”他最出色的表现之一是在 10 月份对阵雷丁的 EFL Trophy 比赛中，当时 Ezenwata 梅开二度，帮助我们在 Select Car Leasing Stadium 以 2-0 获胜。除了精彩的进球外，值得注意的是这位 18 岁球员的力量和对抗高级对手的能力。 Ezenwata 透露，这是他自从加入 CNG 球队以来一直致力于进一步提高的一个领域。他说：“我真的很喜欢雷丁比赛；这对我来说是一个很好的挑战。显然，想要进入一线队，拥有英格兰联赛杯的经验并取得两个进球，我真的为此感到自豪。 “我觉得我已经适应了这些条件，显然我的身体素质也是如此。我最大的发展点之一就是我的套牢打法。我在训练中做了更多的工作，做额外的事情。就我的终结而言，我也只是继续这样做。尽管今年 9 月才满 18 岁，但 Ezenwata 已经成为我们科巴姆下一代球队的关键人物，担任副队长，并在球场内外以身作则。他还在青年欧洲联赛首回合对阵弗洛拉塔林的比赛中佩戴了队长袖标，并在那场比赛中攻入一球。这位蓝军前锋承认他感到有责任，但也很享受这个角色并得到队友的信任。他说：“担任这个角色意义重大，所以我将继续努力。从赛季开始到现在，你可以看到团结程度不断增强。我们都是相互联系为一体的。在一起玩得越多，我们就越能了解每个人的能力和个性。”自从来到切尔西之后，缘渡发展迅速。上赛季，他在所有比赛中打入 21 粒进球和 9 次助攻，其中包括我们在斯坦福桥战胜曼城的 18 岁以下英超联赛全国决赛中的首开纪录，帮助我们锁定了冠军。在此之前，Ezenwata 在 2024/25 赛季表现出色，是 18 岁以下青年队的常规首发球员，并最终成为球队的最佳射手。此后，他一直是 CNG 的领军人物，最近签署了一份新合同，让他在俱乐部至少效力到 2029 年 6 月。回顾迄今为止与蓝军的旅程，Ezenwata 说：“当我 15 岁时来到切尔西，我感到非常兴奋。”我和我的家人都很自豪，切尔西现在对我来说就是全世界；全职工作，一周又一周地踢球，享受我的足球。 “上赛季对阵曼城的决赛并赢得了决赛，是我迄今为止在切尔西最自豪的时刻。看到每个人都走上球场，全场比赛的情绪是不真实的。 “这个赛季，它签署了我的新合同。这是朝着正确方向迈出的又一步，表明我的努力得到了回报，所以我将继续努力，争取更多。”在足球之外，埃森瓦塔仍然具有令人难以置信的天赋。最近他的钢琴技巧在网上引起了关注，这让这位年轻前锋感到惊讶。 Ezenwata 告诉我们：“我没想到会有这么多人；当我环顾四周时，你可以在视频末尾看到。我四岁时开始玩游戏，通过 YouTube 自学并学习童谣。从那以后我就一直这样做——它帮助我放松。”视频中 Ezenwata 演奏的歌曲是他最喜欢演奏的，因为这是他最近学习的歌曲，并且花了“一段时间”来完善。然而，这还不是他学过的最难的，高追的《溺爱》位居榜首。展望本赛季剩余时间，埃森瓦塔为自己设定了成为英超第二射手的目标，并誓言将继续努力实现这一目标。当我们月底对阵诺维奇城时，他将有机会增加自己不断增长的进球数。

news.title: Chelsea's Player of the Month for October 2026 revealed!
news.title_zh: 切尔西 2026 年 10 月月度最佳球员揭晓！
news.body_en: Morgan Rogers' impressive start to life at Stamford Bridge continued in October, with the forward voted Chelsea's Player of the Month by users of the Chelsea Official App. The summer signing featured in all five of our matches during the month, playing 444 of the 450 minutes available across four Premier League fixtures and our Carabao Cup tie. He helped the Blues secure three league victories and enjoyed his most productive month since arriving in West London. Rogers scored three goals during October, two in the Premier League and one in the cup, as he continued to establish himself as a pivotal member of Xabi Alonso's attack. His regular involvement underlined the importance he has quickly gained within the team, with the forward becoming a consistent presence in our starting line-up. His standout moment came against Manchester United at Stamford Bridge, when he opened the scoring with a sensational individual effort. Collecting the ball from Romeo Lavia just inside the centre-circle, the 24-year-old embarked on a powerful run through the heart of the visitors' defence and into the penalty area before delicately lifting his finish over the despairing goalkeeper. It was a goal of exceptional quality and one which was recognised by Blues supporters, with Rogers receiving the Chelsea Goal of the Month award for October. It was the second consecutive month he had claimed that prize, having also been voted September's winner for his volley against Arsenal. The England international's attacking contribution was reflected in his numbers, with ten shots across his five appearances, while he also featured twice for his country during the international break. His willingness to drive forward from midfield and take on opposition defenders has added another dimension to our attacking play, while his ability to operate in different areas of the forward line has made him a valuable option for Alonso. Rogers has made an excellent impression since joining the club in the summer and has already reached ten goal involvements in all competitions this season, underlining the impact he has made in the early stages of his Chelsea career. He finished top of the October Player of the Month poll on the Chelsea Official App with 36 per cent of the vote. Romeo Lavia was second with 30 per cent, followed by Mike Penders on 18 per cent, Pedro Neto on nine per cent and Jordan Henderson on seven per cent.
news.body_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯在斯坦福桥的令人印象深刻的开局在十月份继续，这位前锋被切尔西官方应用程序的用户评选为切尔西本月最佳球员。这位夏季签约球员参加了我们这个月的所有五场比赛，在四场英超联赛和卡拉宝杯比赛的 450 分钟时间内踢了 444 分钟。他帮助蓝军取得了三场联赛胜利，并度过了自抵达西伦敦以来最高效的一个月。罗杰斯在十月份打进了三个进球，其中两个是在英超联赛中，一个是在杯赛中，他继续将自己确立为哈维·阿隆索进攻中的关键成员。他的定期参与突显了他在球队中迅速获得的重要性，这位前锋成为我们首发阵容中的稳定存在。他最出色的时刻是在斯坦福桥对阵曼联的比赛中，当时他以精彩的个人射门首开纪录。这位 24 岁的球员在中圈内接到罗密欧·拉维亚 (Romeo Lavia) 的传球，开始强有力的冲刺，穿过客队防线的中心地带，进入禁区，然后巧妙地将射门越过绝望的门将。这是一个品质卓越的进球，得到了蓝军球迷的认可，罗杰斯获得了切尔西十月最佳进球奖。这是他连续第二个月获得该奖项，并因对阵阿森纳的比赛中的凌空抽射而被评为九月获胜者。这位英格兰国脚的进攻贡献体现在他的数据上，他在五场比赛中射门十次，同时他还在国际比赛日期间为国家队出场两次。他愿意从中场向前推进并对抗对方后卫，这为我们的进攻增添了另一个维度，而他在前锋线不同区域的运作能力使他成为阿隆索的宝贵选择。罗杰斯自夏天加盟俱乐部以来给人留下了极好的印象，本赛季在所有比赛中已经打入十粒进球，突显了他在切尔西职业生涯早期所产生的影响。他以 36% 的得票率在切尔西官方应用程序的 10 月最佳球员投票中名列前茅。罗密欧·拉维亚（Romeo Lavia）以 30% 的支持率位居第二，其次是迈克·彭德斯（Mike Penders），支持率为 18%，佩德罗·内托（Pedro Neto）为 9%，乔丹·亨德森（Jordan Henderson）为 7%。

news.title: Match report: Chelsea Women 1-0 Manchester City
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：切尔西女足 1-0 曼城
news.body_en: Chelsea moved to the top of the Women's Super League with a huge victory over Manchester City at Stamford Bridge, ending the visitors' unbeaten league record and moving one point clear of them at the summit. Sandy Baltimore's stunning strike in first-half stoppage time proved decisive in a hard-fought contest. The Blues had to withstand considerable pressure after the break, but defended resolutely before City goalkeeper Ayaka Yamashita was sent off for bringing down Alyssa Thompson outside her penalty area. We remained a threat on the counter and came close to adding a second, but Baltimore's goal was enough to secure three precious points. The result maintains our unbeaten start to the season in all competitions and gives us a significant advantage in the race for the WSL title. The early stages at Stamford Bridge were played at a high tempo, with chances at both ends in an entertaining start to the contest. Manchester City created the first opportunity when Khadija Shaw broke down the left and cut the ball back for Aoba Fujino, whose effort went wide of Hannah Hampton's goal. We responded immediately, with Melvine Malard holding off the City defence before laying the ball into the path of Alyssa Thompson, but the American international fired high and wide. City continued to threaten, but Katie McCabe produced an excellent interception in the eighth minute to prevent Fujino from having another sight of goal. We came close to taking the lead two minutes later. Malard beat Iman Beney down the left and sent in a cross, which took a slight deflection, forcing Ayaka Yamashita into an excellent save. There was an early change for the Blues in the 12th minute, as Veerle Buurman replaced Kadeisha Buchanan in defence. Lexi Potter was shown the first yellow card of the afternoon three minutes later after catching Sam Coffey, before Ellie Carpenter used her pace to get away from the City defence on the right. The Australian drove towards goal but dragged her shot wide of the far post. Our attacking threat continued to grow. McCabe played a superb pass inside the full-back to release Thompson down the left in the 21st minute, and her cross found its way to Carpenter at the far post after Malard had been unable to make contact. Carpenter struck first time, but Rebecca Knaak cleared the ball from inside the six-yard box with Malard waiting to pounce. Baltimore then sent a dangerous cross into the area, which Malard narrowly failed to reach, as City struggled to deal with our attacking play. We were enjoying more possession and creating the better opportunities, although a breakthrough remained elusive. City had a rare effort in the 26th minute when Sydney Wamser tried her luck from around 25 yards, but her shot sailed wide of Hampton's goal. There was an injury concern for us when Malard went down in the 34th minute and, unable to continue, was replaced by Aggie Beever-Jones. The Blues continued to press City and eventually had the final say before the interval. Our pressure was finally rewarded in the fourth minute of added time, as Baltimore produced a stunning finish to put us ahead. City had been caught trying to play out from the back, and we took full advantage by pressing high and winning possession in their half. Buurman won an aerial challenge near halfway before Carpenter held off the City defence and carried the ball forward down the right. City briefly regained possession, but Hasegawa was unable to escape the pressure from Carpenter and Kaptein, who won the ball back. Potter laid it off to Kaptein, who found Carpenter on the right. The full-back then picked out Baltimore inside the penalty area. The French international had time to turn and set herself before unleashing a thunderous strike into the top corner, giving Yamashita no chance and sending Stamford Bridge into delirium. It was a wonderful goal and a deserved reward for our growing dominance. We had looked the more threatening side as the half progressed, shading possession and creating the better chances, and Baltimore's late strike gave us the advantage our first-half performance merited. It was to be Baltimore’s final impact on the game with the attacker replaced by Maika Hamano at the break. City immediately tried to find a way back into the contest after the break, but their first effort on target did not come until the 57th minute when Fujino collected a pass from Shaw. Her tame shot was straight at Hampton, who made a comfortable save. After soaking up the pressure, we continued to threaten at the other end, with McCabe playing a wonderful pass to release Thompson. The forward embarked on a winding run before sending a cross into the area, which was intercepted by the City defence. Our fifth corner followed on the hour mark. McCabe's delivery was cleared, but Bronze returned the ball into the box and Kaptein reacted quickest to the loose ball. Under pressure from Yamashita and Shaw, however, her header went just over the crossbar. The visitors then missed a golden opportunity to equalise. Shaw beat Bronze to the ball before lifting the ball over Hampton, but Hemp somehow failed to make contact at the far post, despite the goal seemingly at her mercy. Carpenter's pressure helped put the England international off, and we survived a major scare. City substitute Miedema soon made her presence felt, playing in Shaw, who cut inside Carpenter before seeing her effort blocked brilliantly by the excellent Buurman. We had a huge opportunity to double our advantage in the 71st minute. Thompson did well to keep the ball alive down the left before sending a cross towards the far post, where Carpenter was completely unmarked. However, the Australian could not make clean contact and fired off target with the goal gaping. City kept on pressing with Fujino skipping past McCabe, but Bronze stepped across to block her effort, before our captain produced another vital intervention to deny Shaw as she prepared to shoot. A decisive moment came in the 75th minute when City goalkeeper Yamashita was sent off. The Japanese international rushed out of her penalty area to meet a ball over the top, but the electric Thompson got there first and knocked it past the onrushing keeper, who brought down our forward. The referee had little choice but to show a straight red card, leaving City with ten players for the closing stages. And we came within inches of making our numerical advantage count immediately; Beever-Jones struck the crossbar from the resulting free-kick, a wonderful effort from distance that was so close to giving us a more comfortable final 15 minutes of action. Despite being down to ten players, City continued to push forward in search of an equaliser, with Bronze continuing to lead our defensive efforts, making another important intervention to prevent Shaw from getting a shot away in the 83rd minute. We remained dangerous on the counter, with Beever-Jones firing wide after a fine run down the left six minutes from time. City had one final opportunity when Beney was played in by Beth Mead in the first minute of added time, but the defender fired over under pressure from the hard-working Thompson. A frenetic, high-quality encounter ended with the Blues claiming all three points to move above City and take the top spot in the WSL. The victory takes us to the top of the Women's Super League, one point ahead of Manchester City, who had been unbeaten in the league and across all competitions before today's meeting. It also extends our own unbeaten start to the season and delivers a significant result against the reigning champions at Stamford Bridge. We host Paris Saint-Germain at the Cherry Red Records Stadium on Wednesday evening (8pm KO) in matchday five of the UEFA Women's Champions League. You can buy your tickets here! 切尔西在斯坦福桥大胜曼城，登顶女足超级联赛榜首，终结了客队联赛不败纪录，以一分的优势领先榜首。桑迪·巴尔的摩在上半场补时阶段的惊人进球在这场激烈的比赛中发挥了决定性作用。中场休息后，蓝军承受了相当大的压力，但在曼城门将山下彩华因在禁区外放倒阿丽莎·汤普森而被红牌罚下之前，蓝军顽强防守。我们在反击中仍然具有威胁，差点再进一球，但巴尔的摩的进球足以确保三分宝贵。这个结果保持了我们本赛季在各项赛事中不败的开局，并让我们在WSL冠军的争夺中占据了显着的优势。斯坦福桥的比赛初期节奏很快，双方都有机会，比赛开局很有趣。曼城创造了第一个机会，卡蒂贾·肖突破左路，将球回切给青叶藤野，后者的射门偏出汉娜·汉普顿的球门。我们立即做出回应，梅尔文·马拉德挡住了曼城的防守，然后将球传给了艾莉莎·汤普森，但这位美国国脚的射门又高又偏。曼城继续威胁，但凯蒂·麦凯布在第8分钟进行了一次出色的拦截，阻止了藤野再次射门。两分钟后我们就差点取得领先。马拉德在左路击败了伊曼·贝尼，送出一记传中，球稍稍偏转，迫使山下彩香做出精彩扑救。蓝军在第 12 分钟就做出了提前换人，维尔勒·布尔曼 (Veerle Buurman) 换下卡德伊沙·布坎南 (Kadeisha Buchanan) 防守。三分钟后，莱克西·波特（Lexi Potter）在抓住萨姆·科菲（Sam Coffey）后​​收到了下午的第一张黄牌，随后埃莉·卡彭特（Ellie Carpenter）利用她的速度摆脱了曼城右侧的防守。澳大利亚人冲向球门，但射门偏出远门柱。我们的进攻威胁继续增长。第21分钟，麦凯布在边后卫内完成一记精彩传球，将汤普森从左路释放出来，在马拉德无法接触到球后，她的传中传给了远门柱的卡彭特。卡彭特率先击球，但丽贝卡·克纳克(Rebecca Knaak)从六码禁区内将球解围，而马拉德则等待着突袭。随后，巴尔的摩向禁区送出一记危险的传中，马拉德差点没能传中，而曼城则难以应对我们的进攻。尽管突破仍然遥不可及，但我们享受了更多的控球并创造了更好的机会。曼城在第26分钟罕见地射门，西德尼·瓦姆瑟(Sydney Wamser)在25码左右尝试运气，但她的射门偏出汉普顿的球门。当马拉德在第 34 分钟倒地并无法继续比赛时，我们有伤病的担忧，被阿吉·比弗-琼斯换下。蓝军继续向曼城施压，最终在中场休息前取得了最终决定权。我们的压力终于在补时第四分钟得到了回报，巴尔的摩队打出了令人惊叹的射门，帮助我们取得了领先。曼城试图从后场进攻，我们充分利用了这一优势，在他们的半场高位逼抢并赢得了控球权。布尔曼在中场附近赢得了一次空中挑战，随后卡彭特顶住了曼城的防守，并将球带到了右路。曼城短暂夺回控球权，但长谷川无法摆脱卡彭特和卡普坦的压力，后者将球权夺回。波特把球传给了卡普坦，后者发现卡彭特在右边。边后卫随后在禁区内挑出了巴尔的摩。这位法国国脚有时间转身定位，然后将一脚雷鸣般的射门打入球门上角，给山下没有机会，让斯坦福桥陷入了疯狂。这是一个精彩的进球，也是对我们日益增强的统治地位的应有回报。随着上半场的进展，我们看起来更具威胁性，遮蔽了控球权并创造了更好的机会，而巴尔的摩队最后的进球给了我们上半场表现应有的优势。这是巴尔的摩对比赛的最后影响，中场休息时攻击者被滨野舞香换下。中场休息后，曼城立即试图找到重新进入比赛的方法，但直到第57分钟藤野接肖的传球才首次射中球门。她温和的射门直接射向汉普顿，汉普顿轻松扑救。 承受住压力后，我们继续在另一端形成威胁，麦凯布精彩传球放开了汤普森。这位前锋开始了蜿蜒的跑动，然后向禁区发出传中，但被曼城后卫拦截。我们的第五个弯道在小时标记后进行。麦凯布的传球被解围，但布朗兹将球送回禁区，卡普坦对球的反应最快。然而，在山下和肖的压力下，她的头球稍稍高出了横梁。随后客队错失了扳平比分的黄金机会。肖在将球举过汉普顿之前击败了青铜，但汉普不知何故未能在远门柱上接触到球，尽管进球似乎由她摆布。卡彭特的压力帮助这位英格兰国脚打消了顾虑，我们也安然度过了一次巨大的恐慌。曼城替补球员米德玛很快就展现了自己的存在，在肖的比赛中，肖内切内切卡彭特，然后看到她的射门被出色的布尔曼精彩地挡出。第71分钟我们有绝佳的机会将优势翻倍。汤普森很好地把球传到了左路，然后将球传向远门柱，而卡彭特完全没有盯防。然而，澳大利亚人未能干净利落地接触球门，射门偏出。曼城继续施压，藤野跳过了麦凯布，但布朗上前阻止了她的射门，然后我们的队长在肖准备射门时再次进行了至关重要的干预，阻止了她的射门。第75分钟，决定性的时刻到来了，曼城门将山下被罚下场。这位日本国脚冲出禁区，接球越过球顶，但汤普森抢先到达，将球撞过冲上来的门将，后者放倒了我们的前锋。裁判别无选择，只能直接出示红牌，曼城在最后阶段只剩下十名球员。我们距离立即发挥人数优势只有几英寸的距离；比弗-琼斯的任意球击中横梁，这是一次精彩的远距离射门，差点让我们在最后 15 分钟的比赛中更加轻松。尽管只有十名球员，曼城仍继续向前推进，寻求扳平比分，布隆泽继续带领我们的防守，在第83分钟再次进行重要干预，阻止了肖的射门。我们在反击中仍然充满威胁，距离比赛结束还有六分钟，比弗-琼斯在左路的一次漂亮跑动后射门偏出。补时第一分钟，贝尼·米德将球传给贝尼，曼城获得了最后的机会，但这名后卫在汤普森的压力下射门高出。一场疯狂、高质量的比赛结束了，蓝军全取三分，超越曼城，登上 WSL 榜首位置。这场胜利让我们登上了女足超级联赛的榜首，领先曼城一分，在今天的比赛之前，曼城在联赛和各项赛事中都保持不败。这也将我们的不败开局延续到了赛季，并在斯坦福桥对阵卫冕冠军时取得了显着的成绩。周三晚上（晚上 8 点），我们将在樱桃红唱片体育场迎战巴黎圣日耳曼队，这是欧洲女子冠军联赛第五轮比赛。您可以在这里购买门票！切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、青铜（中）、布坎南（布尔曼 news.title: Confirmed Chelsea Women line up vs Manchester City
news.title_zh: 确认切尔西女足对阵曼城的阵容
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has made four changes to her Chelsea side for this afternoon's top-of-the-table Women's Super League clash against Manchester City at Stamford Bridge. Following Tuesday's goalless draw against Hacken in the Women's Champions League, the Blues return to domestic action looking to leapfrog City and move to the top of the league table. Hannah Hampton returns between the posts in place of Livia Peng, while there are two changes in defence, with Kadeisha Buchanan and Katie McCabe coming into the starting XI in place of Nathalie Bjorn and Veerle Buurman. Sandy Baltimore also returns to the side, replacing Sjoeke Nusken, who is named among the substitutes. Elsewhere, Lexi Potter retains her place in the starting XI alongside Keira Walsh and Wieke Kaptein, while Alyssa Thompson and Melvine Malard both start once again. Chelsea: Hampton, Carpenter, Buchanan, Bronze (c), McCabe, Walsh, Kaptein, Potter, Thompson, Baltimore, Malard. Chelsea substitutes: Peng, Bjorn, Buurman, Las, Cuthbert, Nusken, Hamano, Brown, Beever-Jones.
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特对切尔西队今天下午在斯坦福桥对阵曼城的顶级女子超级联赛的比赛进行了四项调整。继周二在女子冠军联赛中0-0战平哈肯之后，蓝军重返国内赛场，希望超越曼城，登上积分榜榜首。汉娜·汉普顿 (Hannah Hampton) 回归，顶替彭莉薇 (Livia Peng) 的位置，而后防线则有两次变动，卡迪莎·布坎南 (Kadeisha Buchanan) 和凯蒂·麦凯布 (Katie McCabe) 取代纳塔莉·比约恩 (Nathalie Bjorn) 和维尔勒·布尔曼 (Veerle Buurman) 进入首发阵容。桑迪·巴尔的摩也回到了球队，取代了替补名单中的舍克·努斯肯。在其他地方，莱克西·波特（Lexi Potter）与凯拉·沃尔什（Keira Walsh）和维克·卡普坦（Wieke Kaptein）一起保留了首发阵容，而艾莉莎·汤普森（Alyssa Thompson）和梅尔文·马拉德（Melvine Malard）都再次首发。切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、布坎南、青铜（中）、麦凯布、沃尔什、卡普坦、波特、汤普森、巴尔的摩、马拉德。切尔西替补：彭、比约恩、布尔曼、拉斯、库斯伯特、努斯肯、滨野、布朗、比弗-琼斯。

news.title: Buchanan on togetherness and WSL title focus ahead of Man City visit
news.title_zh: 布坎南在访问曼城之前谈团结和WSL冠军焦点
news.body_en: Kadeisha Buchanan believes Chelsea have the quality and togetherness to reclaim the Women's Super League title this season – and is determined to help the Blues make a statement against current champions Manchester City this afternoon at Stamford Bridge. We welcome City to SW6 in a contest between the WSL's top two. Only two points separate the teams after nine games, and neither has yet tasted defeat this term. Victory for Sonia Bompastor's side would see us leapfrog City and return to the summit, and Buchanan, who has been part of a Chelsea defence that has conceded just five league goals this term, believes the Blues are ready for the challenge ahead. 'It's at Stamford Bridge, so we're confident,' the Canadian international said. 'I think the last time we played them at Stamford Bridge, we started off defensively strong. And this season, with the stingy back line we have, I think we'll be in a better space. 'If we have that strong start and clean up a few things in defence, I think we'll be very confident in that game.' City arrive in west London boasting an impressive record of their own, with 25 points earned from a possible 27 and Bunny Shaw leading the WSL scoring charts with 12 goals. Buchanan is well aware of the threat posed by the Jamaican forward and believes limiting her opportunities will be crucial to Chelsea's chances of success. 'I think we've got to try to stop the service into Bunny any way possible and be strong physically,' she said. 'I do feel like we've had a good start to this season in both competitions. I think we are in a good space and just hope to keep it like that and improve as the season goes on.' Buchanan also believes our strong start to the campaign has been built on the understanding and togetherness within Bompastor's squad. Seven victories and two draws from our opening nine WSL fixtures have kept us near top spot, and we have also made a strong start to our UEFA Women's Champions League campaign. 'I think the more we work together, the more we move as one,' explained Buchanan.  'It's about team compactness, moving together, knowing our team-mates, knowing how Lucy (Bronze) plays, knowing how Nat (Bjorn) plays, knowing how Veerle (Buurman) plays, knowing how everyone plays on the field so then you can best support them as well.' That collective spirit will be tested against a City side who ended our run of six consecutive WSL titles last season. But while today's opponents represent an obstacle in our pursuit of silverware this term, Buchanan insists the Blues' motivation comes from within rather than from a desire for revenge. 'I can't speak for everyone – it's each to their own – but I don't think it's about them,' she said. 'I think it's about Chelsea and, going off that, I think it's ours to take. 'It [the title] was ours and we lost it. They didn't win it; we lost it. So I feel it's the same this season: it's ours to take if we truly want it, and it's about just not letting it slip this year. 'Win against Man City at home and we're on top. I think after that game, hopefully we get the result we need, we'll be in a really good space.'
news.body_zh: 卡德莎·​​布坎南相信切尔西有能力和团结来夺回本赛季的女足超级联赛冠军，并决心帮助蓝军在今天下午在斯坦福桥对阵现任冠军曼城的比赛中发表声明。我们欢迎曼城来到 SW6，参加 WSL 前两名之间的较量。九场比赛过后，两队仅相差两分，本赛季双方都没有尝过失败的滋味。索尼娅·邦帕斯托的球队若取得胜利，我们将超越曼城，重返巅峰，布坎南是切尔西后防线的一员，本赛季只丢了五个联赛进球，他相信蓝军已经准备好迎接未来的挑战。 “这是在斯坦福桥，所以我们有信心，”这位加拿大国脚说。 “我认为上次我们在斯坦福桥对阵他们时，我们一开始防守就很强。这个赛季，凭借我们的后防线，我认为我们会处于一个更好的空间。 “如果我们有一个强劲的开局并在防守中清理一些东西，我想我们会对那场比赛非常有信心。”曼城抵达伦敦西部，拥有自己令人印象深刻的战绩，在可能的 27 分中获得 25 分，邦尼·肖 (Bunny Shaw) 以 12 个进球领跑 WSL 得分榜。布坎南很清楚牙买加前锋所构成的威胁，并相信限制她的机会对于切尔西的成功机会至关重要。 “我认为我们必须尽一切可能阻止对兔子的服务，并保持身体强壮，”她说。 “我确实觉得我们本赛季在两项比赛中都有一个良好的开局。我认为我们处于一个很好的空间，希望能够保持这样的状态，并随着赛季的进行而不断进步。”布坎南还相信，我们在竞选中的强劲开局是建立在邦帕斯托队内部的理解和团结的基础上的。前九场 WSL 比赛中，我们取得了 7 场胜利和 2 场平局，这让我们接近榜首，而且我们在欧洲女子冠军联赛中也取得了良好的开局。 “我认为我们合作得越多，我们就越团结一致，”布坎南解释道。  “这是关于团队的紧凑性、一起行动、了解我们的队友、了解露西（铜牌）如何打球、了解纳特（比约恩）如何打球、了解维尔勒（布尔曼）如何打球、了解每个人在场上的表现，这样你也可以最好地支持他们。”这种集体精神将在对阵上赛季结束了我们WSL六连冠的曼城队的比赛中受到考验。尽管今天的对手是我们本赛季追求奖杯的障碍，但布坎南坚持认为蓝军的动机来自内部，而不是出于复仇的欲望。 “我不能代表所有人——这是每个人自己的看法——但我不认为这与他们有关，”她说。 “我认为这是关于切尔西的，而且，我认为这是我们的。 “它[标题]是我们的，但我们失去了它。他们没有赢得胜利；而是他们赢得了胜利。我们失去了它。所以我觉得这个赛季也是一样的：如果我们真的想要它，它就是我们的，而且今年只是不要让它溜走。 “在主场战胜曼城，我们处于领先地位。我认为在那场比赛之后，希望我们能得到我们需要的结果，我们将处于一个非常好的空间。”

news.title: Internationals: Caicedo on target as he leads Ecuador to victory
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：凯塞多带领厄瓜多尔取得胜利
news.body_en: Moises Caicedo scored Ecuador's second goal as they beat Costa Rica 2-0, with the Chelsea midfielder captaining his country in the victory. The 25-year-old was his usual all-action self in midfield, contributing important defensive work while also getting forward to support Ecuador's attack. His performance was capped in the 83rd minute when he stepped up to take a penalty and put the result beyond doubt. Caicedo struck the ball powerfully and low into the bottom-left corner, giving the Costa Rica goalkeeper no chance, registering his fourth international goal in 66 appearances for Ecuador. The Chelsea midfielder was given the opportunity to rest after his contribution, being substituted immediately after finding the net. His leadership has also been evident at club level this season, with Caicedo having worn the captain's armband for the Blues on several occasions. Chelsea youngster Kendry Paez was also included in the Ecuador squad but did not feature against Costa Rica. Ecuador's next fixture comes on 17 November, when they face Bolivia at 11pm UK time. Meanwhile, none of Chelsea's Argentine trio of Emi Martinez, Valentin Barco and Aaron Anselmino featured in Argentina's 2-1 defeat to Uruguay in an exhibition match. At Under-20 level, Jacob Hall featured for the USA as they took on Japan in Atlanta. The Samurai Blue claimed a 2-0 victory, with both goals already scored by the time Hall was introduced from the substitutes' bench in the 71st minute. The 17-year-old Chelsea academy product was unable to help his side find a way back into the contest. Hall will have another opportunity to impress on international duty in the early hours of Sunday morning, when the USA Under-20s take on Colombia.
news.body_zh: 莫伊塞斯·凯塞多 (Moises Caicedo) 攻入厄瓜多尔队的第二个进球，帮助厄瓜多尔 2-0 击败哥斯达黎加，这位切尔西中场队长带领厄瓜多尔队取得了胜利。这位25岁的球员在中场一如既往地全能，在防守上做出了重要贡献，同时也前插支持厄瓜多尔的进攻。他的表现在第83分钟被封顶，当时他挺身而出主罚点球，让结果变得毫无疑问。凯塞多大力将球打入左下角，没有给哥斯达黎加门将任何机会，这是他为厄瓜多尔出场 66 场比赛中的第四个进球。这名切尔西中场球员在进球后获得了休息的机会，在进球后立即被替换下场。本赛季他的领导力在俱乐部层面也很明显，凯塞多曾多次佩戴蓝军队长袖标。切尔西年轻球员肯德利·帕埃斯也入选了厄瓜多尔队名单，但没有在对阵哥斯达黎加的比赛中出场。厄瓜多尔的下一场比赛将于 11 月 17 日举行，届时他们将在英国时间晚上 11 点迎战玻利维亚。与此同时，切尔西的阿根廷三人组埃米·马丁内斯、瓦伦丁·巴尔科和亚伦·安塞尔米诺都没有在阿根廷1-2输给乌拉圭的表演赛中出场。在 20 岁以下级别比赛中，雅各布·霍尔 (Jacob Hall) 代表美国队在亚特兰大迎战日本队。武士蓝队以 2-0 获胜，霍尔在第 71 分钟从替补席上替补上场时，两粒进球都已经打进。这位17岁的切尔西青训出身的球员没能帮助他的球队重新回到比赛中。周日凌晨，当美国 20 岁以下青年队迎战哥伦比亚队时，霍尔将有另一个机会在国际比赛中给人留下深刻印象。

news.title: Late Stamford Bridge winners: the semi-final vote
news.title_zh: 斯坦福桥已故获胜者：半决赛投票
news.body_en: It is now time for Chelsea fans to decide which two late winning goals scored at Stamford Bridge in the Premier League should advance to the final! There have been plenty of last-gasp deciders to enjoy over the years, and now we are asking you to pick your favourite. To help shorten our very lengthy longlist, we limited our selections to Premier League winners. And they must have been scored in the 85th minute or later. In the quarter-final vote, goals from William Gallas, Estevao Willian, Frank Lampard and Cole Palmer advanced to take their place in today's semi-finals. Those four goals are split into two ties. Watch them back and then vote for your favourite on the Chelsea Official App, with the winners progressing to Monday's grand final! Vote for your favourite late Stamford Bridge winners! We’ve also added a few lines on each goal for added context if you need help making your mind up! William Gallas vs Tottenham - 2006 On the day the King of Stamford Bridge Peter Osgood died, William Gallas conjured up a dramatic late winner from distance at Ossie's beloved Shed End. Estevao Willian vs Liverpool - 2025 We don't think we need to remind you about Estevao's sliding stoppage-time winner against the reigning champions Liverpool last year! Frank Lampard vs Stoke City - 2009 Trailing 1-0, Juliano Belletti drew us level with two minutes to go before Lampard won it in stoppage time with a rising left-footed drive that had the foundations of the Bridge shaking. Cole Palmer vs Man United - 2024 The second-latest winner in Premier League history - after 100 minutes and 41 seconds - was scored by Cole Palmer at the conclusion of a topsy-turvy epic in which our attacker had already equalised deep into stoppage time. Vote for your favourite late Stamford Bridge winners!
news.body_zh: 现在是时候让切尔西球迷决定英超联赛中在斯坦福桥打进的两个最后时刻的制胜进球应该晋级决赛了！多年来，有很多最后一刻的决定者可以享受，现在我们请您选择您最喜欢的。为了缩短我们冗长的名单，我们将选择范围限制为英超冠军。而且他们一定是在第85分钟或更晚的时候进球的。在四分之一决赛的投票中，威廉·加拉斯、埃斯特沃·威廉、弗兰克·兰帕德和科尔·帕尔默的进球晋级今天的半决赛。这四个进球分为两队。观看他们的比赛，然后在切尔西官方应用程序上投票选出您最喜欢的球员，获胜者将晋级周一的总决赛！投票选出你最喜欢的已故斯坦福桥冠军得主！如果您需要帮助做出决定，我们还在每个目标上添加了几行内容以添加背景信息！威廉·加拉斯 vs 托特纳姆热刺 - 2006 在斯坦福桥之王彼得·奥斯古德去世的那天，威廉·加拉斯在奥西心爱的谢德恩德球场从远处召唤出戏剧性的最后胜利者。埃斯特沃·威廉 vs 利物浦 - 2025 我们认为我们不需要提醒您去年埃斯特沃在对阵卫冕冠军利物浦的补时阶段的绝杀！弗兰克·兰帕德 vs 斯托克城 - 2009 年 0-1 落后的情况下，朱利亚诺·贝莱蒂在比赛还剩两分钟时将我们扳平，但兰帕德在伤停补时阶段的左脚射门让大桥的地基都摇晃起来，赢得了比赛。科尔·帕尔默 vs 曼联 - 2024 英超历史上第二晚的制胜球——在 100 分 41 秒后——由科尔·帕尔默打进，结束了一场混乱的史诗般的比赛，我们的攻击手在伤停补时阶段已经扳平比分。投票选出你最喜欢的已故斯坦福桥冠军得主！

news.title: Iconic Chelsea shirts reimagined for Christmas
news.title_zh: 标志性的切尔西球衣为圣诞节重新设计
news.body_en: Chelsea’s new Christmas jumpers have arrived, just in time for the festive party season, so you can show your passion for the Blues and your holiday spirit at the same time. Retro is the theme for Christmas at Stamford Bridge this year, with two of Chelsea’s most iconic kits reimagined in Christmas jumper form, producing the kind of knitwear that will really stand out from the crowd at the office party or family lunch on Christmas Day itself. Shop the full range of Chelsea Christmas jumpers here For Christmas 2026, we are taking things back to the turn of the millennium with a distinctive and ever-popular away shirt from the Nineties, as well as the home kit that kicked off Chelsea’s 21st Century with silverware. Christmas is a time for family, and that was also on people’s minds when Blues skipper Dennis Wise carried his infant son up the famous old Wembley steps to collect the FA Cup trophy after our 1-0 victory over Aston Villa in the 2000 final. It was a truly historic moment, providing one of Chelsea and the FA Cup’s all-time iconic images, as well as being the last time anyone would lift club football’s oldest trophy under the twin towers of the traditional home of the English game, before Wembley was demolished and rebuilt. The shirt our legendary captain Wise was wearing as he did so – one of the most popular retro jerseys still frequently seen in the stands at the Bridge – has now been turned into a Christmas jumper in time for this year’s festivities. There have been a few alterations to add a festive touch, with Christmas-themed messaging replacing the sponsors, while on the back the space reserved for players’ name and number reads ‘Merry 26’, paying tribute to another legendary Blues skipper John Terry, who was taking his early steps in senior football wearing the No26 shirt during the 1999/00 campaign. Our other new Christmas jumper offering mimics the unmistakable away kit worn by Chelsea for the 1994/95 and 1995/96 seasons, instantly recognisable both for its bold design and the era it is associated with. The orange and grey became iconic of a hugely important period in Chelsea’s history, when manager Glenn Hoddle rebuilt the club in his image, being the shirt worn during the debut seasons of global stars like Ruud Gullit, Dan Petrescu and Mark Hughes. Those were the campaigns that laid the groundwork and provided the spark for the most successful spell in Chelsea's history. Of course, those are just two of many Christmas jumpers available from Chelsea, with traditional options also on offer for those who prefer to keep things more festive. You can browse the entire range of Chelsea Christmas jumpers here and pick the perfect one for you.
news.body_zh: 切尔西的新款圣诞套头衫已经到货，正好赶上节日派对季节，因此您可以同时展现对蓝调的热情和节日精神。复古是今年斯坦福桥圣诞节的主题，切尔西最具标志性的两套球衣以圣诞毛衣的形式重新设计，打造出在圣诞节办公室派对或家庭午餐中真正脱颖而出的针织品。在此购买全系列切尔西圣诞套头衫 2026 年圣诞节，我们将推出 90 年代独特且广受欢迎的客场球衣，以及以奖杯开启切尔西 21 世纪的主场球衣，将一切带回到千禧年之际。圣诞节是家人团聚的时刻，2000 年决赛中我们 1-0 战胜阿斯顿维拉后，蓝军队长丹尼斯·怀斯抱着年幼的儿子走上著名的老温布利台阶，领取足总杯奖杯，这也引起了人们的关注。这是一个真正的历史性时刻，提供了切尔西和足总杯历史上的标志性形象之一，也是在温布利被拆除和重建之前最后一次有人在英格兰足球传统主场的双塔下举起俱乐部足球最古老的奖杯。我们的传奇队长怀斯当时所穿的衬衫是蓝桥看台上最受欢迎的复古球衣之一，现在已被改造成圣诞节套头衫，以迎接今年的庆祝活动。为了增添节日气氛，球衣进行了一些改动，以圣诞节为主题的信息取代了赞助商，而背面为球员姓名和号码保留的空间写着“Merry 26”，向另一位传奇蓝军队长约翰·特里致敬，他在 1999/00 赛季穿着 26 号球衣迈出了成年足球的第一步。我们的另一款全新圣诞套头衫模仿了切尔西在 1994/95 和 1995/96 赛季所穿的明显客场球衣，因其大胆的设计和与之相关的时代而立即被认出。橙色和灰色成为切尔西历史上一个非常重要时期的标志，当时主教练格伦·霍德尔以他的形象重建了俱乐部，成为路德·古力特、丹·佩特雷斯库和马克·休斯等全球球星在首个赛季所穿的球衣。这些战役为切尔西历史上最成功的时期奠定了基础并提供了火花。当然，这些只是切尔西提供的众多圣诞套头衫中的两款，对于那些喜欢让气氛更加喜庆的人来说，也可以选择传统的选择。您可以在这里浏览切尔西圣诞毛衣的全系列，并挑选最适合您的一件。

news.title: Key talking points from Sonia Bompastor's pre-Man City press conference
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托在曼城赛前新闻发布会上的主要谈话要点
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor faced the media at Cobham ahead of our huge Women's Super League clash against Manchester City on Saturday, and here are the main talking points from what the Blues head coach said. Bompastor answered the assembled journalists' questions about the game, in which the top two teams in the WSL prepare to face off for the first time this season - with just a couple of points separating the sides. The head coach reported that Lauren James and Naomi Girma will be unavailable until the conclusion of this block of fixtures next weekend, prior to the forthcoming international break. And here are the rest of the key talking points from our head coach’s pre-match press conference on Friday as she looked ahead to a mouthwatering contest. ‘From what you could see from the beginning of the season, probably both teams will want to win the game, and both teams will attack to win the game. ‘Probably you will see goals tomorrow, hopefully for everyone, and not too much for us in terms of conceding! ‘It’s never easy to play teams who are sitting in the low block and not really allowing you to find spaces. I think this game will be different, for sure, in terms of space on the pitch. We need to be smart to recognise that and exploit it.’ ‘The two last results have been frustrating for us, so it's good to see from the players' reaction, but also the staff reaction, that we are hungry. ‘We have hunger going into the game tomorrow. We need to keep working, and I'm convinced we'll create opportunities, and we need to make sure we are clinical. ‘Many things can happen when you are in those moments, and we keep working on the pitch, providing details to the players, reviewing the games, trying to understand what we can do even better to make sure we are able to score in every game.’ ‘She's been really good. She's a player who is able to defend but also to attack, as you could see this season. ‘She’s able to run through that outside corridor. She has improved a lot in terms of the quality of her crossing, but also when she gets in the box, the decision-making on the ball. ‘She's scored some great goals and she's making an impact for us. Even if sometimes people think she can be predictable in what she's doing, she's still really good at doing what she does.’ ‘If we go focus too much on her, another player from Man City will find a way maybe to create and score a goal. We know that because they have a lot of quality as a team, but also they have a lot of great individuals. ‘We believe in the quality of the players we have on the pitch as well. We believe in what we are doing as a team also to defend, especially in the box. We proved that already when we played against Arsenal, when we played against Lyon in the Champions League. ‘We were able to not concede much during those games, we took some learnings, and we'll try to apply the same for the game tomorrow.’ ‘In that game, the mental aspects were the most important ones. When you are leading at home by two goals and you have 15 minutes left in the game, I think you can't let the game go the way it went. ‘But it happens. We took the learnings, and what we know from that game and the quality City has on their side, from minute one until the end of the game they have the opportunity to be a good team and to score at any time. ‘So obviously we know we will have to be a good team from minute one until the end of the game, and make sure we are really switched on.’ See the Blues in action against Man City at Stamford Bridge! Tickets are available here...
news.body_zh: 在周六对阵曼城的女超联赛之前，索尼娅·邦帕斯特在科巴姆接受了媒体采访，以下是蓝军主教练所说的主要谈话要点。庞帕斯特回答了现场记者关于这场比赛的问题，这场比赛是 WSL 两支顶级球队准备在本赛季首次交锋的比赛，双方的积分差距仅几分。主教练报告说，劳伦·詹姆斯和娜奥米·吉尔玛将无法上场，直到下周末即即将到来的国际比赛日之前这一系列比赛结束。以下是我们主教练周五赛前新闻发布会上的其余关键谈话要点，她展望了一场令人垂涎的比赛。 “从赛季初的情况来看，两支球队可能都想赢得比赛，并且都会进攻以赢得比赛。 “明天你可能会看到进球，希望每个人都能进球，而我们的失球也不会太多！ “与那些坐在低位、不允许你找到空间的球队比赛从来都不是一件容易的事。我认为这场比赛在球场空间方面肯定会有所不同。我们需要聪明地认识到这一点并利用它。” “最后两个结果让我们感到沮丧，所以很高兴从球员的反应和工作人员的反应中看到我们很饥饿。 “我们对明天的比赛充满渴望。我们需要继续努力，我相信我们会创造机会，我们需要确保我们是临床的。 “当你处于那种时刻时，很多事情都会发生，我们会继续在球场上努力，向球员提供细节，回顾比赛，试图了解我们可以做得更好，以确保我们能够在每场比赛中进球。”她是一位既能防守又能进攻的球员，正如你在本赛季看到的那样。 “她能够跑过外面的走廊。她的传中质量有了很大提高，而且当她进入禁区时，她的控球决策也有了很大提高。 “她打进了一些伟大的进球，她正在对我们产生影响。 “即使有时人们认为她可以预测她所做的事情，但她仍然非常擅长做她所做的事情。” “如果我们过多关注她，来自曼城的另一名球员也许会找到一种方法来创造并进球。我们知道这一点，因为他们作为一个团队具有很高的素质，而且他们也有很多优秀的个人。 `我们也相信场上球员的素质。我们相信我们作为一个团队所做的事情以及防守，尤其是在禁区内。当我们对阵阿森纳时，当我们在冠军联赛中对阵里昂时，我们已经证明了这一点。 “我们在那些比赛中没有丢太多球，我们学到了一些东西，我们会尝试在明天的比赛中应用同样的东西。” “在那场比赛中，心理方面是最重要的。”当你在主场领先两球并且比赛还剩15分钟时，我认为你不能让比赛继续这样发展。 ‘但它确实发生了。我们吸取了教训，从那场比赛中学到了知识，以及曼城的实力，从第一分钟到比赛结束，他们都有机会成为一支优秀的球队，并随时得分。 “所以显然我们知道我们必须从第一分钟到比赛结束都是一支优秀的球队，并确保我们真正处于状态。”观看蓝军在斯坦福桥对阵曼城的比赛！门票可以在这里购买...

news.title: Sonia Bompastor named WSL Manager of the Month
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 被评为 WSL 月度最佳经理
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has been named Women's Super League Manager of the Month after guiding the Blues to three victories from our three league matches in October. Bompastor's side enjoyed a perfect October in the WSL, netting 12 goals and conceding just three as we maintained our unbeaten start to the campaign. The month began with an impressive 3-0 win away at West Ham United, before the Blues returned to Stamford Bridge following the international break to secure a thrilling 6-2 victory over London rivals Tottenham Hotspur. That derby triumph marked Bompastor's 50th WSL match in charge of Chelsea, with the Blues head coach setting a new WSL record of 125 points from her opening 50 games. In our final league fixture of October, we came from behind to claim a 3-1 victory over Crystal Palace, with Melvine Malard scoring twice in the second half to secure all three points. It is the fifth time Bompastor has received the WSL Manager of the Month award since taking charge in the summer of 2024.
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 带领蓝军在 10 月份的三场联赛中取得三场胜利，被评为本月女超联赛最佳主教练。邦帕斯托的球队在 ​​WSL 中度过了一个完美的 10 月份，攻入 12 个进球，仅丢 3 个球，保持了赛季不败的开局。这个月伊始，蓝军客场3-0战胜西汉姆联队，随后蓝军在国际比赛日后回到斯坦福桥，以6-2惊心动魄地击败伦敦对手托特纳姆热刺队。这场德比的胜利标志着邦帕斯托执教切尔西的第 50 场 WSL 比赛，这位蓝军主教练在她的前 50 场比赛中创造了新的 WSL 记录，即 125 分。在十月份的最后一场联赛中，我们后来居上，以 3-1 战胜水晶宫，梅尔文·马拉德在下半场梅开二度，全取三分。这是 Bompastor 自 2024 年夏天上任以来第五次获得 WSL 月度最佳经理奖。

news.title: Bompastor updates on James and Girma availability ahead of Man City
news.title_zh: 博姆帕斯特在曼城之前更新了詹姆斯和吉尔马的可用情况
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor confirmed that Lauren James and Naomi Girma are progressing well on their return from injury, but she expects our next match against Manchester City to be too soon for them to be involved. Chelsea face a huge Women’s Super League fixture on Saturday, when we host Manchester City at Stamford Bridge in a top-of-the-table clash. After dropping WSL points for the first time since our opening game of the season, we now sit two points behind leaders Man City, but can retake first place with a home win this weekend. However, the Blues will have to do so without the help of James or Girma, after our manager gave an update on the progress of their recovery from injury. ‘I think LJ is good, but I don’t think we expect to see her in this block,’ said Bompastor, in her pre-match press conference on Friday afternoon. ‘That’s the same for Nay. She’s now more in advance, not far from starting again to train with the team. ‘So both of them are doing good, but we won’t see them in this block with us.’ Even without those two, Bompastor still has plenty of talent at her disposal for this massive WSL fixture, and is confident her team has what it takes to secure what could be a crucial victory in the title race in front of our home support at the Bridge. ‘In terms of that the two teams are unbeaten, it is an important game between two teams that are performing at a really good level, but not the only ones obviously. ‘I think tomorrow it’s a game worth three points, like the other ones, but in terms of the psychological aspects, the team that is able to win will take maybe a psychological advantage. ‘So we are playing at home and we approach every game the same, tomorrow won’t be different. We want to come to the game and bring some confidence, but also try to win the game. I know we have the ability to do that so we will try our best. ‘The game plan is ready. We’ve only had a few training sessions after the Hacken game, but I feel the team is in a good place and ready for the game tomorrow.’ Secure your seat at the Bridge to cheer the team on against Man City! Tickets are still available.
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特证实劳伦·詹姆斯和娜奥米·吉尔玛伤愈复出后进展顺利，但她预计我们下一场对阵曼城的比赛对他们来说还为时过早。周六，切尔西将面临一场重要的女足超级联赛比赛，届时我们将在斯坦福桥迎战曼城，这是一场积分榜榜首的比赛。自赛季首场比赛以来，WSL 积分首次下降，目前我们落后领头羊曼城两分，但本周末可以通过主场胜利重新夺回第一名。然而，在我们的主教练通报了伤病恢复进展的最新情况后，蓝军将不得不在没有詹姆斯或吉尔马帮助的情况下做到这一点。 “我认为 LJ 很好，但我认为我们不会期望在这个街区看到她，”邦帕斯特在周五下午的赛前新闻发布会上说道。 '对奈来说也是如此。她现在已经提前了很多，距离重新开始和球队一起训练已经不远了。 “所以他们俩都做得很好，但我们不会看到他们和我们一起出现在这个街区。”即使没有这两个人，邦帕斯特仍然有足够的天赋来参加这场大规模的 WSL 比赛，并且相信她的球队有能力在我们桥牌主场的支持者面前确保在冠军争夺战中取得关键的胜利。 “就两队不败而言，这是两支表现非常出色的球队之间的一场重要比赛，但显然不是唯一的比赛。 “我认为明天的比赛和其他比赛一样，是一场值得三分的比赛，但从心理方面来说，能够获胜的球队可能会占据心理优势。 “所以我们是在主场比赛，我们对待每场比赛都是一样的，明天不会有什么不同。我们想要来到比赛中并带来一些信心，但也要努力赢得比赛。我知道我们有能力做到这一点，所以我们会尽力而为。 ‘比赛计划已经准备好了。在与哈肯的比赛后，我们只进行了几次训练，但我觉得球队状态良好，为明天的比赛做好了准备。” 在桥上预留座位，为球队对阵曼城的比赛加油！门票仍然有售。

news.body_en: We can now reveal which four memorable Chelsea late winning goals have advanced to the semi-finals in our vote held on the Chelsea Official App. We asked supporters to choose their favourite late Premier League winner at Stamford Bridge in four separate pairings. The first to progress was William Gallas, whose spectacular strike against Tottenham edged out his compatriot Frank Leboeuf with 67 per cent of the vote. It was more clear cut in the second quarter-final, where Estevao's winner against Liverpool last season triumphed with an 89 per cent share over the vote, beating Claude Makelele's goal on the day we lifted the Premier League title for the first time. Our third semi-finalist is Frank Lampard, who sparked pandemonium at the Bridge when he completed a late comeback against Stoke in 2009. That received 61 per cent of the vote when paired with Willian's decider in a 1-0 win over Everton six years later. Cole Palmer also advanced, with his late, late deflected strike in the 4-3 epic with Manchester United two-and-a-half years ago. He beat off competition from Fernando Torres, who settled a top-of-the-table clash against Manchester City in 2013. Make sure to return tomorrow (Saturday) to cast your vote in the semi-finals!
news.body_zh: 现在，我们可以在切尔西官方应用程序上进行的投票中揭晓哪四个令人难忘的切尔西最后制胜进球已晋级半决赛。我们要求球迷在斯坦福桥的四对不同组合中选出他们最喜欢的已故英超联赛冠军。第一个晋级的是威廉·加拉斯，他在对阵托特纳姆热刺队的比赛中的精彩进球以67%的选票击败了同胞弗兰克·勒博夫。第二个四分之一决赛的情况更加明显，埃斯特沃上赛季对阵利物浦的制胜球以89%的得票率获胜，击败了克劳德·马克莱莱在我们首次捧起英超冠军那天的进球。我们的第三位半决赛选手是弗兰克·兰帕德，他在 2009 年对阵斯托克城的比赛中完成逆转，在蓝桥引发了一片混乱。六年后，当威廉的决胜球帮助球队 1-0 战胜埃弗顿时，他的得票率高达 61%。科尔·帕尔默（Cole Palmer）也晋级，两年半前，他在曼联 4-3 史诗般的比赛中，在最后时刻射门偏出。他击败了费尔南多·托雷斯，后者在 2013 年对阵曼城的比赛中击败了费尔南多·托雷斯。请务必在明天（周六）回来在半决赛中投票！

news.title: Mike Penders save voted Premier League’s best
news.title_zh: 迈克·潘德斯扑救被评选为英超最佳扑救
news.body_en: Mike Penders has received the Premier League Save of the Month award for October for his stunning stop against Manchester United. The Blues goalkeeper had competition from five others on the shortlist, but the public vote picked Penders’ save as the best in the Premier League during October. The save which claimed the award came late in our 2-0 win over Manchester United at Stamford Bridge, just one week after the 21-year-old’s full league debut. He showed quick reflexes and excellent agility to divert Bryan Mbeumo’s powerful drive onto the crossbar with his fingertips, keeping his clean sheet intact. It wasn’t just the Premier League supporters casting their vote for the award who were so impressed by the Belgian’s reflexes, as he admitted that even some of his team-mates found it almost too good to believe. ‘The ball came so quickly, I didn’t even see it properly,’ said Penders on his award-winning stop. ‘It was just instinct, pure instinct, a reaction. I felt a good touch on my fingertips and, after that moment, I screamed all the positive emotions out. I had to, I was so happy with that moment. ‘Then, after the game, no-one believed me that I touched it! I was like: “Yeah, I touched it, you will see afterwards”. ‘Then it was pretty quickly on Twitter. A team-mate came into the dressing room saying: “He touched it”. I was very happy it was a good angle, because if the angle wasn't right, they could still have some doubts!’ Penders becomes the third Chelsea goalkeeper to receive the Premier League Save of the Month award since it was introduced for the start of the 2022/23 season, following Kepa Arrizabalaga and Robert Sanchez (twice).
news.body_zh: 迈克·潘德斯因对阵曼联的精彩扑救而荣获十月份英超联赛最佳扑救奖。这位蓝军门将与入围名单上的其他五名门将展开竞争，但公众投票认为彭德斯的扑救是十月份英超联赛中最好的扑救。获得该奖项的扑救发生在我们在斯坦福桥2-0战胜曼联的比赛中，距离这位21岁的球员完成联赛首秀仅一周后。他表现出快速的反应和出色的敏捷性，用指尖将布莱恩·姆博莫的强力射门转移到横梁上，保持了不失球。比利时人的反应给这个奖项留下了深刻的印象，不仅是英超联赛的支持者投票支持了这一奖项，他也承认，就连他的一些队友也觉得这个奖项好得令人难以置信。 “球来得太快了，我什至都没有看清它，”潘德斯在他获奖的停球中说道。 “这只是本能，纯粹的本能，一种反应。我感觉到指尖有一种很好的触感，在那一刻之后，我尖叫出了所有积极的情绪。我必须这样做，那一刻我感到非常高兴。 ‘然后，比赛结束后，没有人相信我碰过它！我当时想：“是的，我触摸了它，之后你就会看到”。 “然后这件事很快就在推特上流传开来。一名队友走进更衣室说：“他碰了它”。我很高兴这是一个很好的角度，因为如果角度不对，他们仍然可能会有一些疑问！”潘德斯成为继凯帕·阿里扎巴拉加和罗伯特·桑切斯（两次）之后，自 2022/23 赛季开始以来第三位获得英超月度最佳扑救奖的切尔西门将。

news.title: Cuthbert on heavyweight Man City clash and 'pivotal' fans' support
news.title_zh: 卡斯伯特谈重量级曼城冲突和“关键”球迷的支持
news.body_en: Erin Cuthbert thinks two of the best sides in women's football will make 'punch after punch' when we face off against Manchester City at Stamford Bridge on Saturday. After winning the Women's Super League last season, Man City head coach Andree Jeglertz has guided them to the top of the table once again this season, but the Blues are chasing hard and sit just two points behind after nine games. Saturday's match couldn't be more finely poised, and when we sat down with our captain Erin Cuthbert, she explained exactly why our fans could be the difference-maker in a match where winning and losing will come down to such fine margins. 'The Stamford Bridge crowd have really excelled in the tough moments this season,' said the skipper. 'There have been times when we've been up against it, but that's when the crowd have got us out of that and swung the momentum back in our favour. 'We’re going to need them against Man City because we're not always going to get it our way. The crowd is going to be really pivotal on Saturday. We feed off their energy. We've needed them at times this season, because it hasn't always been plain sailing, despite how many goals we’ve scored and clean sheets we’ve earned. 'Neither side will play for a point; we’ll both be going for the three points, and hopefully that should see the fans turn out in numbers, because they're going to see a game that both sides want to win right until the very end. 'I expect it to be a very high-quality game, but also to be quite edgy at the same time, because both teams want to win, but both teams don't want to lose. So it's a fine balance between whether you go and risk it all, or hold on to what you've got. I know the team will go for it right until the final whistle, and if we're still in it, we'll be going gung-ho, and if we are winning, we'll fight to keep it that way.' Erin Cuthbert is well used to winning silverware at Chelsea. Joining the club in 2016, she only missed out on our first two trophies, and has lifted 18 since then. The Scotland international was a key member of the side that won six consecutive WSL titles before Man City's success last year, and she's determined to see it back in our hands at the end of the campaign. 'It was our trophy for six years before last season, so of course it feels like it's been taken away,' she explains. 'But Man City were rightful winners last year and beat us comfortably in the end. 'There is a degree of wanting to claim what's ours, because it had been ours for so long, but nobody has any given right to the title. It's built through hard work and grinding out wins, good, bad and ugly, across the season, and we're going to need that. 'We know Man City have it just now, so we have to do everything and more. I've been in the position where we've been top of the table, and we've won the league, so I know what it feels like when teams are chasing you. You feel them breathing down your neck. They're coming for you. You feel that in every game. 'It’s a bit different to be the ones chasing. We're part of the chasing pack now, so it's certainly a different mentality, and you're seeing something maybe a bit different this year: that we're so hungry for it.' Those watching will be in for a treat on Saturday, as the Bridge will showcase the very best of what the WSL has to offer as the top two sides battle it out for the three points. If Man City come out to attack, they could break the trend of visiting sides sitting deep in a low block, and that would give our forwards the space to show what they can do. And although for Cuthbert it is just another opportunity to earn three points, another part of her feels that winning the game will make a big statement about our intentions this season. 'Both teams know the quality each other has got at both ends of the pitch,' the captain continues. 'Man City have a very certain style of play. They're not going to sit back and just take pressure from us all game. They're going to come out fighting, and they have really good technical players who can hurt us, but equally we have those players too. It's going to be punch after punch from both sides. 'Their attacking intent could leave spaces that we might not always have in the league, and it opens up a different type of play for a couple of our players in the team to shine. So it's certainly an exciting one, but also one where we're probably going to be a little bit busier defensively, and we expect that. 'It’s something that the team's ready for, because I think defensively we've done really well this season, and I think big credit goes to the backline and everybody else because the job's been monumental so far.' Answer Erin's call to action and secure your seat at the Bridge to cheer the team on against Man City! Tickets are available here.
news.body_zh: 艾琳·库斯伯特认为，周六我们在斯坦福桥对阵曼城时，女足最好的两支球队将“一拳接着一拳”。上赛季夺得女超联赛冠军后，曼城主教练安德烈·耶格勒茨本赛季带领曼城再次登上积分榜榜首，但蓝军紧追不舍，在九场比赛后仅落后两分。周六的比赛保持着完美的平衡，当我们与队长艾琳·卡斯伯特坐下来时，她准确地解释了为什么我们的球迷可以在一场胜负如此微弱的比赛中发挥重要作用。 “斯坦福桥球迷在本赛季的艰难时刻确实表现出色，”队长说道。 “有时候我们会遇到困难，但那是观众让我们摆脱困境并将势头重新转向对我们有利的时候。 “我们在对阵曼城的比赛中需要他们，因为我们并不总是能如愿以偿。周六的人群将会非常关键。我们以他们的能量为食。本赛季我们有时需要他们，因为尽管我们打进了多少球并赢得了多少零封，但事情并不总是一帆风顺。 “双方都不会为了一分而战；我们都会争取三分，希望这能看到球迷的数量，因为他们将看到一场双方都希望赢得比赛直到最后一刻的比赛。 “我希望这将是一场非常高质量的比赛，但同时也会非常紧张，因为两支球队都想赢，但两支球队都不想输。因此，要在冒着一切风险去冒险，还是坚持现有的东西之间找到一个很好的平衡。我知道球队会一直努力到终场哨声响起，如果我们仍然在场，我们就会斗志昂扬，如果我们赢了，我们就会努力保持这种状态。艾琳·库斯伯特已经习惯了在切尔西赢得奖杯。她于 2016 年加入俱乐部，只错过了我们的前两座奖杯，此后她已经举起了 18 座奖杯。在去年曼城取得成功之前，这位苏格兰国脚是球队连续六次获得WSL冠军的关键成员，她决心在赛季结束时将冠军重新交到我们手中。 “在上个赛季之前，这是我们的奖杯六年了，所以当然感觉它已经被拿走了，”她解释道。 “但是曼城去年是合法的赢家，最终轻松击败了我们。 “人们在一定程度上想要夺回属于我们的东西，因为它已经属于我们太久了，但没有人拥有任何获得这个头衔的权利。它是通过整个赛季的努力工作和磨砺胜利而建立的，无论是好的、坏的还是丑陋的，我们都需要它。 “我们知道曼城现在已经做到了，所以我们必须做一切事情，甚至更多。我一直处于积分榜榜首的位置，而且我们赢得了联赛冠军，所以我知道当球队追赶你时是什么感觉。你感觉到他们在你脖子上呼吸。他们来找你了。你在每场比赛中都能感受到这一点。 “成为追赶者有点不同。我们现在是追逐者的一部分，所以这肯定是一种不同的心态，今年你会看到一些不同的东西：我们非常渴望它。周六观看比赛的观众将大饱眼福，大桥将展示 WSL 的最佳表现，两支前两名球队将争夺三分。如果曼城出击，他们可以打破客队深入低位的趋势，这将为我们的前锋提供展示能力的空间。尽管对库斯伯特来说这只是另一个获得三分的机会，但她的另一部分感觉赢得比赛将充分表明我们本赛季的意图。 “两支球队都知道对方在球场两端的实力，”队长继续说道。 “曼城有非常确定的比赛风格。他们不会袖手旁观，在比赛中承受我们的压力。他们会出来战斗，他们有非常好的技术球员，可以伤害我们，但同样我们也有这些球员。双方都会一拳接着一拳。 “他们的进攻意图可能会留下我们在联盟中并不总是有的空间，这为我们队中的一些球员提供了一种不同类型的比赛方式，让他们大放异彩。所以这无疑是一件令人兴奋的事情，但同时我们的防守可能会更加忙碌，我们对此也有预期。 “球队已经做好了准备，因为我认为本赛季我们在防守方面做得非常好，我认为后防线和其他所有人都功不可没，因为到目前为止，这项工作是具有里程碑意义的。”响应艾琳的行动号召，确保在桥上的席位，为球队对阵曼城的比赛加油！门票可在此处购买。

news.title: Chelsea’s first-ever central London pop-up store opens for Christmas season
news.title_zh: 切尔西首家伦敦市中心快闪店于圣诞节期间开业
news.body_en: A new location in Covent Garden brings Chelsea merchandise and festive gifting to the heart of the capital. Chelsea Football Club today announces the opening of our first-ever retail pop-up store in central London, bringing a range of official merchandise, festive gifts and supporter favourites to the heart of the city's Christmas shopping district. Located at 6 Monmouth Street in Covent Garden, the pop-up store is open seven days a week from 12 November to 21 December. It is designed to make Chelsea gifting more accessible than ever for supporters and visitors looking for Christmas presents, while introducing the club's retail offering to a wider audience in central London. Among the many items in store are three designs of Christmas jumper, festive pyjamas and Proper Chels t-shirts and hoodies, plus smaller items including baubles, stockings, scarves and Santa’s hats, and even a festive jumper for dogs. That is in addition to all-year-round best-sellers like our home, away and third kits, and many ideas for stocking fillers. As part of the club’s continued commitment to supporting local communities, a percentage of sales from our festive range will contribute to our Christmas campaign - That's Proper Chels. The initiative supports people experiencing loneliness across London through the work of Chelsea Foundation and charities, including Age UK Kensington & Chelsea, Katherine Low Settlement and Fulham Good Neighbours. The Chelsea FC Christmas Pop-Up Store will be open: 6 Monmouth Street, Covent Garden, London WC2H 9HB Three- to five-minute walk from Covent Garden tube station on the Piccadilly Line If you cannot make it along to Covent Garden or the Megastore at Stamford Bridge, the Chelsea Christmas range is available from our online store.

news.title: Once a Blue: Ron Harris
news.title_zh: 曾经的蓝色：罗恩·哈里斯
news.body_en: To mark the 82nd birthday of our record appearance maker Ron Harris, we revisit an interview he conducted reflecting on his illustrious Chelsea career. ‘Chopper’ Harris made his Blues debut in 1962 and his final appearance in 1980, 795 games and 14 goals later. He was the captain that lifted our first FA Cup trophy and first piece of European silverware, in the form of the Cup Winners’ Cup. Chopper’s Chelsea journey was quite a ride, so buckle up and enjoy this Q&A… Can you remember your first appearance way back in 1962? I captained the England youth side on the Wednesday and we won some little World Cup, and Tommy Docherty was there with my parents. He told me I'd be in the first team on the Saturday for the game against Sheffield Wednesday. We won 1-0 with Mickey Harrison getting the goal, and I marked a lad called Johnny Fantham. It was a real thrill for me as a 17-year-old lad. You had to bide your time before getting a proper run in the team, didn't you? I did stay in the team for a few games, but we went up to Everton and got hammered. That was it for me until the next year; we got relegated and in the Second Division I got a chance later in the season and we ended up getting promoted. The last game was against Portsmouth and we had to win to go up. I think the final score was 7-0! After that, I think I was a regular until my old team-mate Eddie McCreadie took over as manager. He was very superstitious and I was sub just about every week, occasionally coming on if someone was injured. I think I set a Chelsea record of playing in two games in one day. He thought I could do with a run-out with the reserves, so I went and played for them, and then they got a taxi to pick me up from Stamford Bridge to take me to Millwall. We were 3-0 down and at half-time Jock Finnieston had to come off so I played the second half. I can't imagine too many have done that – and I went to training the next day! Clear something up for us – were you a full-back or a centre-half? Because I wasn't gifted with pace, I enjoyed playing alongside the centre-half. I wasn't a big, dominant fella – I'm 5ft 8in – but you learned how to cope in other ways, using your body in the right way to compete against bigger players. I don't know the exact statistics but I think I played just as many games as a full-back as I did as a central defender. When I first came into the side I just man-marked people: Besty, Greavsie, Denis Law. Wherever they went, I used to follow. If I never touched the ball in a game and they didn't either, I knew I'd done a good job. I have to say, the hardest to man-mark was George Best – well, he was the hardest to try and kick! For a fella who was frail and skinny, he wasn't a coward. He could hold his own against anybody. Right foot, left foot; inside or out, he could take you wherever he wanted. I played against Pele a couple of times, too, but I think Best was the best I ever came across. I don't know, but we all got on very well. There was always a players' lounge and it was only for the players and their wives and girlfriends. There was no animosity if you'd given someone a hard time on the pitch – once the final whistle was blown, everything was forgotten. What I can say is that I'd love to have played with Besty, he gave me a few chasings. Having spent the best part of two decades in the first team, I imagine it must be pretty hard for you to highlight your favourite games for the club... Bearing in mind I didn't score too many during my career, we took on the Hammers just before the 1966 World Cup at Stamford Bridge and I scored two fantastic goals. I sliced one past Peter Bonetti for an own goal and then I went up the other end and hit a fantastic volley past Jim Standen! So that's one game. Then, in the 1971 Cup Winners' Cup run, me and Ossie didn't play in the first leg against Club Brugge when we lost 2-0, but we came back for the return and won 4-0. They were a useful side so that was a memorable game. Obviously the replay against Leeds United in the 1970 FA Cup final is another that stands out more than most, when we beat a tremendous side and became the first Chelsea team to lift the FA Cup. Then there's the European Cup Winners' Cup in Athens – another replay! We lost a goal in the last few seconds of the final, which was played on the Wednesday, and then on the Friday we had a replay and won 2-1. You've picked quite a few cup games there. I guess it sums up Chelsea during your time there, doesn't it? I've always said we were so inconsistent in the league – we could beat anybody on our day, but often when it came to taking on the lesser sides we'd go and get beaten. But with the cup games, the bigger the crowd, the better our star men responded. We had a great team. Peter Bonetti was fantastic in goal and the back four didn't take any prisoners; John Hollins did a great job in midfield while Charlie Cooke and Huddy pulled the strings, and Peter Houseman was a workaholic on the wing; and then you've got Hutch, who was a perfect foil for Ossie. I have to say, Os was the one of the best players I ever played alongside. He was tough as well as incredibly skilful. We had such a camaraderie. If one of the lads was getting a bit of a rough time on the pitch then there'd be one of their mates to help them out. I was privileged to captain a bunch of great lads and tremendous players. The closest you came to winning the league was in the 1964/65 season, when the Blues were top with three games left to play. Was that the year of the Blackpool incident? I've spoken to Tom [Docherty] on many occasions and I think he'll tell you that's the one thing he regretted. We had games against Burnley and Blackpool coming up so we went up there to stay for a few days. Tom said, “You've got to be in at a certain time” and everyone came back, but then some of them snuck out through the fire escape. He ended up sending them home, bringing in a load of youngsters, and we got beaten 6-2 against Burnley. I scored in that game, but I'd have preferred the win. Anyway, that put paid to our chances. The atmosphere between the lads and Tom was off – the whole situation got blown out of proportion and upset the apple cart. If he'd have just fined them a week's wages then I think we'd have probably gone on to win the league. Is that a regret from your time at Chelsea? Not a regret, but it would have been nice. It was the closest we ever came to the title. The balance of the side was the bigger the game, the better they performed. I'm not being disrespectful to some of the less fashionable sides in the First Division, but we just didn't perform against them on the smaller stage. You mention how long you spent at the club, but did you ever consider leaving before finally moving on for Brentford in 1980? I remember captaining England Under-23s when Bill Nicholson was manager and he asked me if I'd be interested in going to the Spurs because they'd love to have me there. But I had absolutely no intention of going there, and they ended up buying Dave Mackay – that was the end of it. Then, when Danny Blanchflower took over as manager we got beaten badly up at Middlesbrough in his first game and things hadn't been going great before that. Danny said to me, “Look, I'll put you in the picture: I'm going with the younger lads. Would you be interested in going to Luton?” David Pleat was the manager at the time and he was someone I'd played alongside at England youth level. Pleaty came round to my house in Epsom for a chat. He told me that I only had to come in to training on a Monday and a Friday – he just needed a bit of an old head for all the youngsters in his squad, someone to look after them. I had two young kids myself at that time and didn't really want to be travelling up there twice a week so I turned them down. Your older brother Allan also played for Chelsea. Does he ever get fed up with being known as Chopper's brother?! I don't think so. In fact, I reckon most people probably remember him for his managerial partnership with Terry Venables at Spurs and Barcelona. He played over 100 games for Chelsea and had the one thing I never did – pace. Was he one of the reasons you joined Chelsea? Yeah. In my day you'd go around all of the clubs so I tried out West Ham, Arsenal, Spurs and others. Then Allan decided on Chelsea and I followed him. When he went there I was a ballboy until I left school. Then I signed for the club. The rest is history – 795 games, 13 or 14 goals depending on you speak to. I'll take the 14, don't worry about that! You almost became a cricketer for Middlesex. What happened? Maybe I'd have done both if the seasons didn't overlap. Ron Tindall always used to miss the start of the football because of the cricket. So I went to see Ted Drake at Chelsea and he offered me £7 per week and a rail pass for the year. I went up to Lord's and was offered £4 per week to join the groundstaff but I had to pay my expenses. I was from a working-class family, so that swayed me. What does it mean to be our record appearance maker? I served under seven managers and what each of them got from me was 110 per cent effort in training and on the Saturday. I'm so proud of playing more games than any other player in the history of Chelsea Football Club and it's a record I don't think will ever be beaten. news.body_zh: 为了纪念出场纪录创造者罗恩·哈里斯 (Ron Harris) 82 岁生日，我们回顾了他对切尔西辉煌职业生涯的采访。 “乔巴”哈里斯于 1962 年首次代表蓝军出场，并于 1980 年最后一次出场，随后出场 795 场比赛，攻入 14 个进球。他是我们的队长，举起了我们的第一座足总杯奖杯和第一座欧洲奖杯——优胜者杯。乔巴的切尔西之旅是一次相当愉快的旅程，所以系好安全带，享受这个问答吧……您还记得 1962 年您第一次亮相吗？周三我担任英格兰青年队队长，我们赢得了一些世界杯，汤米·多切蒂和我的父母一起在那里。他告诉我，我将在周六对阵谢菲尔德星期三的比赛中进入一线队。我们以 1-0 获胜，米基·哈里森 (Mickey Harrison) 进球，我盯防了一个名叫约翰尼·范瑟姆 (Johnny Fantham) 的小伙子。对于 17 岁的我来说，这真是一件令人兴奋的事。你必须等待时机才能在团队中得到适当的发挥，不是吗？我确实在球队呆了几场比赛，但我们去了埃弗顿并遭到了重击。这对我来说就是这样，直到明年。我们降级了，在赛季后期我在乙级联赛中获得了机会，最终我们升入了乙级联赛。上一场比赛是对阵朴茨茅斯，我们必须赢球才能晋级。我认为最终比分是7-0！在那之后，我认为我是一名常客，直到我的老队友埃迪·麦克雷迪接任主教练。他非常迷信，我几乎每周都会替补，偶尔在有人受伤时上场。我想我创造了切尔西一天踢两场比赛的纪录。他认为我可以和预备队一起出局，所以我去为他们效力，然后他们叫了一辆出租车从斯坦福桥接我到米尔沃尔。我们0-3落后，半场结束时乔克·芬尼斯顿不得不下场，所以我踢了下半场。我无法想象有太多人这样做了——第二天我就去参加了训练！为我们澄清一些事情——你是边后卫还是中后卫？因为我没有速度天赋，所以我喜欢和中卫一起踢球。我不是一个高大、有统治力的家伙——我身高 5 英尺 8 英寸——但你学会了如何以其他方式应对，以正确的方式利用你的身体与更大的球员竞争。我不知道确切的统计数据，但我认为我作为边后卫踢的比赛和作为中后卫踢的比赛一样多。当我第一次上场时，我只是盯防其他人：贝斯蒂、格里夫西、丹尼斯·劳。他们走到哪里，我就跟到哪里。如果我在一场比赛中从未触球而他们也没有触球，我就知道我做得很好。我不得不说，最难盯防的是乔治·贝斯特——好吧，他是最难尝试踢球的！对于一个又弱又瘦的小伙子来说，他并不是一个胆小鬼。他可以坚持自己的立场来对抗任何人。右脚，左脚；无论里面还是外面，他都可以带你去任何他想去的地方。我也和贝利交手过几次，但我认为贝斯特是我遇到过的最好的。我不知道，但我们相处得很好。总有一个球员休息室，仅供球员及其妻子和女朋友使用。如果你在球场上给某人制造了麻烦，那也不会产生敌意——一旦终场哨声吹响，一切都会被忘记。我能说的是，我很想和贝斯蒂一起打球，他给了我一些追逐。在一线队度过了二十年最美好的时光，我想你一定很难突出你最喜欢的俱乐部比赛……考虑到我在职业生涯中进球不多，1966年世界杯前夕我们在斯坦福桥迎战铁锤帮，我打进了两个精彩的进球。我切入彼得·博内蒂的乌龙球，然后我走到另一端，打出一记精彩的凌空抽射，越过吉姆·斯坦登！这就是一场比赛。然后，在1971年的优胜者杯比赛中，我和奥西在首回合对阵布鲁日的比赛中没有上场，当时我们0-2输球，但我们反击并以4-0获胜。他们是一支很有用的球队，所以这是一场令人难忘的比赛。显然，1970 年足总杯决赛对阵利兹联队的重赛是另一场比大多数比赛更引人注目的比赛，当时我们击败了一支强大的球队，成为第一支举起足总杯的切尔西队。然后是在雅典举行的欧洲优胜者杯赛——另一场重赛！周三的决赛我们在最后几秒丢了一球，周五我们重赛并以 2-1 获胜。你在那里挑选了很多杯赛。我想这就是你在切尔西期间的总结，不是吗？ 我总是说我们在联赛中的表现非常不稳定——我们可以击败任何人，但在对阵实力较弱的球队时，我们常常会被击败。但随着杯赛的进行，观众越多，我们的明星球员的反应就越好。我们有一支很棒的团队。彼得·博内蒂（Peter Bonetti）的进球非常出色，后防线上的四名球员没有俘获任何人。约翰·霍林斯（John Hollins）在中场表现出色，查理·库克（Charlie Cooke）和哈迪（Huddy）在幕后操纵，彼得·豪斯曼（Peter Houseman）在边路是个工作狂；然后还有哈奇，他是奥西的完美陪衬。我不得不说，奥斯是我搭档过的最好的球员之一。他很坚强，也非常有技巧。我们曾有过这样的友情。如果其中一个小伙子在球场上遇到了一些困难，那么他们的队友就会帮助他们摆脱困境。我很荣幸能带领一群伟大的小伙子和出色的球员。最接近赢得联赛冠军是在 1964/65 赛季，当时蓝军在还剩三场比赛时排名第一。那一年是布莱克浦事件发生的一年吗？我曾多次与汤姆[多赫蒂]交谈过，我想他会告诉你这是他后悔的一件事。我们即将对阵伯恩利和布莱克浦的比赛，所以我们去那里呆了几天。汤姆说：“你必须在某个时间进去”，然后每个人都回来了，但随后其中一些人从防火梯溜了出去。他最终把球队送回家，引进了很多年轻球员，我们以 6-2 击败了伯恩利。我在那场比赛中进球了，但我更希望获胜。无论如何，这让我们失去了机会。小伙子们和汤姆之间的气氛很不融洽——整个局势变得不成比例，搅乱了苹果车。如果他只罚他们一周的工资，那么我想我们可能会赢得联赛冠军。这是你在切尔西时期的遗憾吗？不是什么遗憾，但如果能这样就好了。这是我们距离标题最近的一次。双方的平衡是比赛规模越大，他们的表现就越好。我并不是对甲级联赛中一些不太时尚的球队不敬，但我们只是没有在较小的舞台上与他们对抗。你提到你在俱乐部呆了多久，但在 1980 年最终转会到布伦特福德之前，你有考虑过离开吗？我记得比尔·尼科尔森担任主教练时担任英格兰 23 岁以下国家队队长，他问我是否有兴趣去马刺队，因为他们很乐意让我在那里。但我完全无意去那里，他们最终买下了戴夫·麦凯——事情就这样结束了。然后，当丹尼·布兰奇弗劳尔（Danny Blanchflower）接任主教练时，我们在他的第一场比赛中在米德尔斯堡惨败，在那之前事情进展得并不顺利。丹尼对我说：“听着，我会把你放在照片里：我要和年轻的小伙子们一起去。你有兴趣去卢顿吗？”大卫·普利特（David Pleat）是当时的主教练，他是我在英格兰青年队并肩作战的人。普莱蒂来到我位于埃普瑟姆的家聊天。他告诉我，我只需要在周一和周五参加训练——他只需要为球队中的所有年轻人提供一个老头脑，有人来照顾他们。当时我自己有两个年幼的孩子，并不想每周去那里两次，所以我拒绝了他们。你的哥哥艾伦也曾为切尔西效力。他是否厌倦了被称为乔巴的兄弟？我不这么认为。事实上，我认为大多数人可能会因为他与热刺和巴塞罗那的特里·维纳布尔斯的管理伙伴关系而记住他。他为切尔西踢了 100 多场比赛，并且拥有我从未拥有过的一件事——速度。他是你加盟切尔西的原因之一吗？是的。在我那个时代，你会走遍所有的俱乐部，所以我尝试了西汉姆联、阿森纳、热刺等球队。然后艾伦决定选择切尔西，我也跟着他。当他去那里时，我是一名球童，直到我离开学校。然后我就和俱乐部签约了。剩下的就是历史了——795 场比赛，13 或 14 个进球，具体取决于你所说的。我会坐14号，不用担心！你差点成为米德尔塞克斯队的板球运动员。发生了什么？如果季节不重叠的话，也许我会两者都做。罗恩·廷德尔总是因为板球比赛而错过足球比赛的开始。所以我去切尔西见了特德·德雷克，他给了我每周 7 英镑和一年的铁路通票。我去了 Lord's，并获得每周 4 英镑的报酬来加入地勤人员，但我必须支付我的费用。 我来自一个工人阶级家庭，所以这影响了我。成为我们的出场记录创造者意味着什么？我在七位主教练手下工作过，他们每个人从我那里得到的都是在训练和周六的训练中付出了 110% 的努力。我为自己比切尔西足球俱乐部历史上任何其他球员出场次数都多而感到自豪，我认为这是一个永远不会被打破的记录。该采访的一个版本首先在切尔西官方比赛日节目中发布。您可以在此处购买该程序的过去版本。
